name: ballerina/tcp
description: This module provides APIs for sending/receiving messages to/from another application process (local or remote) over the connection-oriented TCP protocol.

typeDefs.name: ClientConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Configurations for the connection-oriented TCP client.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description:
The socket reading timeout value to be used in seconds. If this is not set, the default value
of 300 seconds(5 minutes) will be used

fields.name: writeTimeout
fields.description:
The socket write timeout value to be used in seconds. If this is not set, the default value
of 300 seconds(5 minutes) will be used

typeDefs.name: ClientSecureSocket
typeDefs.description: Secure Socket configuration for TCP Client.

fields.name: cert
fields.description: Configurations associated with `crypto:TrustStore` or single certificate file that the client trusts

fields.name: ciphers
fields.description:
List of ciphers to be used
E.g., `TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256`, `TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA`

typeDefs.name: ListenerConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Provides a set of configurations for tcp listener.

fields.name: secureSocket
fields.description: The SSL configurations for the listener

typeDefs.name: ListenerSecureSocket
typeDefs.description: Secure Socket configuration for TCP Listener.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Configurations associated with `crypto:KeyStore` or combination of certificate and (PKCS8) private key of the server

fields.name: ciphers
fields.description:
List of ciphers to be used
E.g., `TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256`, `TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA`

typeDefs.name: CertKey
typeDefs.description: Represents a combination of the certificate, private key, and private key password (if encrypted).

fields.name: keyFile
fields.description: A file containing the private key in PKCS8 format

fields.name: keyPassword
fields.description: Password of the private key if it is encrypted

typeDefs.name: ConnectionService
typeDefs.description: Represent TCP Listener ConnectionService service type.

typeDefs.name: Listener
typeDefs.description:
Initializes the TCP listener based on the provided configurations.
```ballerina
 listener Listener|error? server1 = new (8080);
```

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the TCP listener based on the provided configurations.
```ballerina
 listener Listener|error? server1 = new (8080);
```

parameters.name: localPort
parameters.description: The port number of the remote service

parameters.name: secureSocket
parameters.description: The SSL configurations for the listener

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Binds a service to the `tcp:Listener`.
```ballerina
tcp:error? result = tcpListener.attach(helloService);
```

return.description: `()` or else a `tcp:Error` upon failure to register the listener

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description: Stops the service listener gracefully. Already-accepted requests will be served before the connection closure.

return.description: An `error` if an error occurred during the listener stopping process

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description: Stops the service listener immediately. It is not implemented yet.

return.description: An `error` if an error occurred during the listener stop process

functions.name: detach
functions.description:
Stops consuming messages and detaches the service from the `tcp:Listener`.
```ballerina
tcp:error? result = tcpListener.detach(helloService);
```

return.description: `()` or else a `tcp:Error` upon failure to detach the service

clients.name: Caller
clients.description: Represents caller object in tcp service remote methods.

functions.name: writeBytes
functions.description: Sends the response as byte[] to the same remote host.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data need to be sent to the remote host

return.description: `()` or else a `tcp:Error` if the given data cannot be sent

`()` or else a `tcp:Error` if the connection cannot be properly
closed

clients.name: Client
clients.description: Initializes the TCP connection client based on the provided configurations.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the TCP client based on the provided configurations.
```ballerina
tcp:Client|tcp:Error? socketClient = new("www.remote.com", 80,
                             localHost = "localHost");
```

parameters.name: remoteHost
parameters.description: The hostname or the IP address of the remote host

parameters.name: remotePort
parameters.description: The port number of the remote host

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description:
The socket reading timeout value to be used in seconds. If this is not set, the default value
of 300 seconds(5 minutes) will be used

parameters.name: writeTimeout
parameters.description:
The socket write timeout value to be used in seconds. If this is not set, the default value
of 300 seconds(5 minutes) will be used

functions.name: writeBytes
functions.description:
Sends the given data to the connected remote host.
```ballerina
tcp:Error? result = socketClient->writeBytes("msg".toBytes());
```

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data that need to be sent to the connected remote host

return.description: `()` or else a `tcp:Error` if the given data cannot be sent

functions.name: readBytes
functions.description:
Reads data only from the connected remote host. 
```ballerina
(readonly & byte[])|tcp:Error result = socketClient->readBytes();
```

return.description: The `readonly & byte[]` or else a `tcp:Error` if the data cannot be read from the remote host

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Frees up the occupied socket.
```ballerina
tcp:Error? closeResult = socketClient->close();
```

return.description: A `tcp:Error` if it cannot close the connection or else `()`

parameters.name: localPort
parameters.description: The port number of the remote service

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: The `onConnect` remote method will be triggered when a message is received from a tcp client
